summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Analytics System and Procure AI Presentation features. All backend analytics endpoints (15/15 tests) passed. Procure AI presentation page fully functional with all 8 sections, navigation controls, and PDF export.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/analytics/summary - Returns comprehensive analytics summary
Backend: GET /api/analytics/users - Returns user analytics with sessions, time, pages
Backend: GET /api/analytics/sessions - Returns session history
Backend: GET /api/analytics/page-views - Returns daily and hourly page view data
Backend: GET /api/analytics/actions - Returns user action analytics
Backend: POST /api/analytics/page-view - Tracks page views
Backend: POST /api/analytics/action - Tracks user actions
Backend: POST /api/analytics/session/start - Starts analytics session
Backend: POST /api/analytics/session/end - Ends analytics session
Backend: POST /api/analytics/heartbeat - Updates session activity
Backend: GET /api/analytics/user/{user_id} - Returns single user analytics
Backend: Analytics endpoints require admin authentication
Backend: Time range filters work (7, 14, 30, 90 days)
Frontend: Analytics tab in Settings loads correctly
Frontend: Analytics shows Total Users, Total Sessions, Page Views, User Actions cards
Frontend: User Activity table displays user data
Frontend: Most Visited Pages section shows page rankings
Frontend: Device Types and Browsers breakdown displayed
Frontend: Recent Sessions table with active/ended status
Frontend: Time range selector (7, 14, 30, 90 days) works
Frontend: Refresh button updates analytics data
Frontend: Procure AI page loads at /proposals/procure-ai (public, no auth)
Frontend: Procure AI - All 8 sections render correctly
Frontend: Procure AI - Next/Previous buttons work
Frontend: Procure AI - Keyboard navigation (arrow keys) works
Frontend: Procure AI - Sidebar page navigation works
Frontend: Procure AI - Download PDF button present and functional
Frontend: Procure AI - Progress bar shows current page
Frontend: Procure AI - Framer-motion animations working
seed_data_creation: Analytics data was generated during testing through page navigation and API calls. Test page views and actions tracked.
